verse.verse_1: Proclaim, (O dear prophet Mohammed – peace and blessings be upon him), “O disbelievers!”
verse.verse_2: Neither do I worship what you worship.
verse.verse_3: Nor do you worship Whom I worship.
verse.verse_4: And neither will I ever worship what you worship.
verse.verse_5: Nor will you worship Whom I worship.
verse.verse_6: For you is your religion, and for me is mine.
